  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 927 4212 9521
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/92742129521

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54724  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-54725  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, March 6, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-54726  Recommendation to accept Categorical Exemption CE-25-012; and

  Page 1 of 3
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 20, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Approve the Modification (MOD24-014) to previously approved Planning
  Commission Approval (Case No. 290-86) and Local Coastal Development Permit
  (LCDP24-048), and adopt the proposed findings and modified conditions of
  approval thereto, to remove Condition No. 23, which limits the total lease area of
  food sales to no more than 30-percent and places this restriction on the property
  title, at the shopping center at 6200 Pacific Coast Highway in the Commercial
  Neighborhood designation of the Southeast Area Specific Plan (SP-2-CN). There
  would be no physical construction associated with this request. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online
at https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
